items.text: During National Salute to Veterans Patients Week, I want to send a special thank you to our veterans. We are forever grateful for your service and sacrifice. https://t.co/vvMLhd7YAo

I consider protecting our God-given right to life as one of my most important responsibilities. I have fought back against Dems challenges to the pro-life message by opposing taxpayer funded abortions & protecting healthcare providers who do not perform abortions. 

Read more ⬇️

If approved, Grace, Idaho will receive $2.5M in funds I requested in the FY23 Interior Appropriations bill for their Wastewater Collection and Treatment Systems Improvement Project. 

The project will make necessary updates & address critical public health needs of the community. https://t.co/kr62idMt2K

As the most accessible healthcare providers in the U.S., pharmacists are essential parts of our communities. I saw this while touring the Fred Meyers pharmacy in Twin Falls. 

Thanks for showing me around & discussing ways Congress can support local pharmacies & their patients. https://t.co/IY7X3dUPO0

The City of Grace needs to modernize its 25-year-old water treatment system, but the expense of such a project can burden businesses and residents with high costs for clean water.

I’m pleased to deliver $2.56M to help the City improve its water treatment capabilities. https://t.co/LWszUIMaig

Providing adequate healthcare for veterans is essential. That is why I am proud to cosponsor the VA Electronic Health Record Modernization Improvement Act. 

This bill will help ensure the EHR is safe and effective for Idaho’s veterans before it is implemented anywhere else.

While intended to provide a streamlined healthcare process for veterans, the EHR system has instead caused confusion, frustration, & a lack of access to care. 

I cosponsored H.R. 592 with @RepBost to prevent further rollout of this system until it is ready to deliver healthcare. https://t.co/tBfjXVp8V6

The national veterinary shortage has severely impacted Idaho, leading to increased treatment costs and labor challenges for veterinary professionals. 

This new school will be an asset in tackling the shortage and bringing more animal healthcare providers to the West.

Proud to have voted to advance the FY25 Military Construction and Veterans Affairs Appropriations Bill out of Committee. 

This bill fully funds veterans' health care programs and benefits and supports national security. https://t.co/ZX0CiY0xoc

Our nation made a promise to care for and support those who have courageously defended our freedoms.

The FY25 Military Construction and Veterans Affairs Appropriations Bill upholds that commitment by fully funding veterans’ health care programs, benefits, and all other veterans’ related programs.

Spent yesterday in Boise touring Merck Animal Health and Franklin Building Supply.
 
I appreciated having the opportunity to visit with employees and see firsthand how these industries support Idaho's economic growth! https://t.co/YJy9HlqbTs

.@IdahoStateU and its researchers are building a remarkable capability to produce medical isotopes at the Idaho Accelerator Center.

As a longtime supporter of this facility, I am pleased we are one step closer to securing funding for the Idaho Accelerator Center Upgrades Project, which will help ISU advance its research capabilities.

For over two centuries, brave men and women have answered the call to defend and protect this great nation. 

To the thousands of veterans and active duty servicemembers across Idaho: I will always fight to ensure you get the treatment you deserve from Washington. 🇺🇸

Constructing a new, larger, and more functional Tribal Health and Human Services Facility for the Shoshone-Bannock Tribes is crucial for the community's well-being.

Pleased that we are one step closer to securing funding for this critical project: a new health services facility in Fort Hall.

It was an incredible honor to tour Gowen Field alongside Idaho’s Adjutant General, Maj. Gen. Donnellan, and fellow Guardsmen. 

We had the privilege of visiting the nearly completed onsite medical training and readiness facility—a project I am proud to have secured funding for in FY22.

Since VP Kamala Harris took office, overall prices are UP 20.5%:

❌ Vehicle insurance is UP 56.5%
❌ Transportation services are UP 40.2%
❌ Gas is UP 38.4%
❌ Vehicle maintenance & repair is UP 32.4% https://t.co/DQNpNT8OOQ

Many thanks to my good friend and colleague, @Robert_Aderholt, the Chairman of the Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education @HouseAppropsGOP Subcommittee, for joining Appropriations 101! 😎🇺🇸

Learn more about how this subcommittee helps our communities, students, and workforce nationwide.

The House passed the Water Resources Development Act this week, which includes my provision that authorizes funding for the City of Burley’s Industrial Wastewater Treatment Plant.

I am proud to fight for Idaho’s priorities and secure this important win for our region!

The new Idaho State Veterans Home in Boise is moving forward—a WIN for Idaho’s veterans.

Ensuring quality health and housing facilities for our veterans is one of my top priorities. I’m grateful for the support of President Trump’s @SecVetAffairs, Doug Collins, in securing the necessary waiver to move this project forward.

Congratulations to Idaho's very own Tom Schultz, who will lead the U.S. Forest Service.

Enhancing forest health and improving management is critical for wildfire suppression efforts and protecting communities and forests. I look forward to working together on these efforts.

WHY are the Democrats spreading misinformation?

The CR has ZERO CUTS to Medicare, Medicaid, or Social Security. 

Read the bill and PASS IT ON. https://t.co/dwWyMCtoBF

Attending the ribbon cutting of the Idaho Air National Guard Medical Training Facility at Gowen Field was an honor.
 
This onsite medical training and readiness facility is an incredible project—one I'm proud to have secured funding for through Community Project Funding. I am proud of the brave men and women of the @IDNationalGuard, and I hope this new medical training facility will help them achieve even greater success.

As Idaho’s only appropriator, I am PROUD to fight for Idaho’s priorities.

Despite claims that CPF projects are “wasteful earmarks,” Community Project Funding allows me to bring Idaho tax dollars back home. The Idaho Air National Guard Medical Training Facility is not wasteful spending—it’s an investment that will help our servicemembers reach even greater heights in their mission and service.

Spent the morning touring @StLukesHealth and discussing the Hospital at Home program.

As a member of the @HouseAppropsGOP Subcommittee on Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, I always appreciate the opportunity to tour facilities that are so critical to the health and wellness of Idahoans.
